verses.original: Ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις ἐξῆλθεν δόγμα παρὰ Καίσαρος Αὐγούστου ἀπογράφεσθαι πᾶσαν τὴν οἰκουμένην
verses.transliteration: Egeneto de en tais hēmerais ekeinais exēlthen dogma para Kaisaros Augoustou apographesthai pasan tēn oikoumenēn
verses.literal: Now in those days a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that a census should be taken of the whole empire
verses.literalPt: E ACONTECEU naqueles dias que saiu um decreto da parte de César Augusto, para que todo o mundo se alistasse

verses.original: αὕτη ἀπογραφὴ πρώτη ἐγένετο ἡγεμονεύοντος τῆς Συρίας Κυρηνίου
verses.transliteration: hautē apographē prōtē egeneto hēgemoneuontos tēs Syrias Kyrēniou
verses.literal: This was the first census to take place while Quirinius was governor of Syria
verses.literalPt: (Este primeiro alistamento foi feito sendo Quirino presidente da Síria).

verses.original: καὶ ἐπορεύοντο πάντες ἀπογράφεσθαι ἕκαστος εἰς τὴν ἑαυτοῦ πόλιν
verses.transliteration: kai eporeuonto pantes apographesthai hekastos eis tēn heautou polin
verses.literal: And everyone went to his own town to register
verses.literalPt: E todos iam alistar-se, cada um à sua própria cidade.

verses.original: Ἀνέβη δὲ καὶ Ἰωσὴφ ἀπὸ τῆς Γαλιλαίας ἐκ πόλεως Ναζαρὲθ εἰς τὴν Ἰουδαίαν εἰς πόλιν Δαυὶδ ἥτις καλεῖται Βηθλεέμ διὰ τὸ εἶναι αὐτὸν ἐξ οἴκου καὶ πατριᾶς Δαυίδ
verses.transliteration: Anebē de kai Iōsēph apo tēs Galilaias ek poleōs Nazareth eis tēn Ioudaian eis polin Dauid hētis kaleitai Bēthleem dia to einai auton ex oikou kai patrias Dauid
verses.literal: So Joseph also went up from - Nazareth in Galilee to Judea to the city of David called Bethlehem since he was from the house and line of David
verses.literalPt: E subiu também José da Galiléia, da cidade de Nazaré, à Judéia, à cidade de Davi, chamada Belém (porque era da casa e família de Davi),

verses.original: ἀπογράψασθαι σὺν Μαριὰμ τῇ ἐμνηστευμένῃ αὐτῷ οὔσῃ ἐγκύῳ
verses.transliteration: apograpsasthai syn Mariam tē emnēsteumenē autō ousē enkyō
verses.literal: He went there to register with Mary who was pledged to him in marriage . . . and was expecting a child
verses.literalPt: A fim de alistar-se com Maria, sua esposa, que estava grávida.

verses.original: Ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν τῷ εἶναι αὐτοὺς ἐκεῖ ἐπλήσθησαν αἱ ἡμέραι τοῦ τεκεῖν αὐτήν
verses.transliteration: Egeneto de en tō einai autous ekei eplēsthēsan hai hēmerai tou tekein autēn
verses.literal: While . . . . . . . . . they were there the time came for her Child to be born
verses.literalPt: E aconteceu que, estando eles ali, se cumpriram os dias em que ela havia de dar à luz.

verses.original: καὶ ἔτεκεν τὸν υἱὸν αὐτῆς τὸν πρωτότοκον καὶ ἐσπαργάνωσεν αὐτὸν καὶ ἀνέκλινεν αὐτὸν ἐν φάτνῃ διότι οὐκ ἦν αὐτοῖς τόπος ἐν τῷ καταλύματι
verses.transliteration: kai eteken ton huion autēs ton prōtotokon kai esparganōsen auton kai aneklinen auton en phatnē dioti ouk ēn autois topos en tō katalymati
verses.literal: And she gave birth to her firstborn a Son She wrapped Him in swaddling cloths and laid Him in a manger because there was no room for them in the inn
verses.literalPt: E deu à luz a seu filho primogênito, e envolveu-o em panos, e deitou-o numa manjedoura, porque não havia lugar para eles na estalagem.

verses.original: Καὶ ποιμένες ἦσαν ἐν τῇ χώρᾳ τῇ αὐτῇ ἀγραυλοῦντες καὶ φυλάσσοντες φυλακὰς τῆς νυκτὸς ἐπὶ τὴν ποίμνην αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: Kai poimenes ēsan en tē chōra tē autē agraulountes kai phylassontes phylakas tēs nyktos epi tēn poimnēn autōn
verses.literal: And there were shepherds residing in the fields nearby keeping watch over their flocks by night
verses.literalPt: Ora, havia naquela mesma comarca pastores que estavam no campo, e guardavam, durante as vigílias da noite, o seu rebanho.

verses.original: καὶ ἄγγελος Κυρίου ἐπέστη αὐτοῖς καὶ δόξα Κυρίου περιέλαμψεν αὐτούς καὶ ἐφοβήθησαν φόβον μέγαν
verses.transliteration: kai angelos Kyriou epestē autois kai doxa Kyriou perielampsen autous kai ephobēthēsan phobon megan
verses.literal: Just then an angel of the Lord stood before them and the glory of the Lord shone around them and they were terrified
verses.literalPt: E eis que o anjo do Senhor veio sobre eles, e a glória do Senhor os cercou de resplendor, e tiveram grande temor.

verses.original: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ ἄγγελος Μὴ φοβεῖσθε ἰδοὺ γὰρ εὐαγγελίζομαι ὑμῖν χαρὰν μεγάλην ἥτις ἔσται παντὶ τῷ λαῷ
verses.transliteration: kai eipen autois ho angelos Mē phobeisthe idou gar euangelizomai hymin charan megalēn hētis estai panti tō laō
verses.literal: But the angel said to them Do not be afraid For behold I bring you good news . . . of great joy that will be for all the people
verses.literalPt: E o anjo lhes disse: Não temais, porque eis aqui vos trago novas de grande alegria, que será para todo o povo:

verses.original: ὅτι ἐτέχθη ὑμῖν σήμερον Σωτήρ ὅς ἐστιν Χριστὸς Κύριος ἐν πόλει Δαυίδ
verses.transliteration: hoti etechthē hymin sēmeron Sōtēr hos estin Christos Kyrios en polei Dauid
verses.literal: Today in the city of David a Savior has been born to you He is Christ the Lord
verses.literalPt: Pois, na cidade de Davi, vos nasceu hoje o Salvador, que é Cristo, o Senhor.

verses.original: καὶ τοῦτο ὑμῖν τὸ σημεῖον εὑρήσετε βρέφος ἐσπαργανωμένον καὶ κείμενον ἐν φάτνῃ
verses.transliteration: kai touto hymin to sēmeion heurēsete brephos esparganōmenon kai keimenon en phatnē
verses.literal: And this will be a sign to you You will find a baby wrapped in swaddling cloths and lying in a manger
verses.literalPt: E isto vos será por sinal: Achareis o menino envolto em panos, e deitado numa manjedoura.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐξαίφνης ἐγένετο σὺν τῷ ἀγγέλῳ πλῆθος στρατιᾶς οὐρανίου αἰνούντων τὸν Θεὸν καὶ λεγόντων
verses.transliteration: Kai exaiphnēs egeneto syn tō angelō plēthos stratias ouraniou ainountōn ton Theon kai legontōn
verses.literal: And suddenly there appeared with the angel a great multitude of the heavenly host praising God and saying
verses.literalPt: E, no mesmo instante, apareceu com o anjo uma multidão dos exércitos celestiais, louvando a Deus, e dizendo:

verses.original: Δόξα ἐν ὑψίστοις Θεῷ καὶ ἐπὶ γῆς εἰρήνη ἐν ἀνθρώποις εὐδοκίας
verses.transliteration: Doxa en hypsistois Theō kai epi gēs eirēnē en anthrōpois eudokias
verses.literal: Glory to God in the highest and on earth peace to men on whom His favor rests
verses.literalPt: Glória a Deus nas alturas, Paz na terra, boa vontade para com os homens.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς ἀπῆλθον ἀπ’ αὐτῶν εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν οἱ ἄγγελοι οἱ ποιμένες ἐλάλουν πρὸς ἀλλήλους Διέλθωμεν δὴ ἕως Βηθλεὲμ καὶ ἴδωμεν τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο τὸ γεγονὸς ὃ ὁ Κύριος ἐγνώρισεν ἡμῖν
verses.transliteration: Kai egeneto hōs apēlthon ap’ autōn eis ton ouranon hoi angeloi hoi poimenes elaloun pros allēlous Dielthōmen dē heōs Bēthleem kai idōmen to rhēma touto to gegonos ho ho Kyrios egnōrisen hēmin
verses.literal: When . . . the angels had left . . . them and gone into heaven the shepherds said to one another Let us go to Bethlehem and see this thing that has happened which the Lord has made known to us
verses.literalPt: E aconteceu que, ausentando-se deles os anjos para o céu, disseram os pastores uns aos outros: Vamos, pois, até Belém, e vejamos isso que aconteceu, e que o Senhor nos fez saber.

verses.original: Καὶ ἦλθαν σπεύσαντες καὶ ἀνεῦραν τήν τε Μαριὰμ καὶ τὸν Ἰωσὴφ καὶ τὸ βρέφος κείμενον ἐν τῇ φάτνῃ
verses.transliteration: Kai ēlthan speusantes kai aneuran tēn te Mariam kai ton Iōsēph kai to brephos keimenon en tē phatnē
verses.literal: So they hurried off and found - Mary and Joseph and the Baby who was lying in the manger
verses.literalPt: E foram apressadamente, e acharam Maria, e José, e o menino deitado na manjedoura.

verses.original: ἰδόντες δὲ ἐγνώρισαν περὶ τοῦ ῥήματος τοῦ λαληθέντος αὐτοῖς περὶ τοῦ παιδίου τούτου
verses.transliteration: idontes de egnōrisan peri tou rhēmatos tou lalēthentos autois peri tou paidiou toutou
verses.literal: After they had seen the Child they spread the message they had received . . . about Him
verses.literalPt: E, vendo-o, divulgaram a palavra que acerca do menino lhes fora dita;

verses.original: καὶ πάντες οἱ ἀκούσαντες ἐθαύμασαν περὶ τῶν λαληθέντων ὑπὸ τῶν ποιμένων πρὸς αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: kai pantes hoi akousantes ethaumasan peri tōn lalēthentōn hypo tōn poimenōn pros autous
verses.literal: And all who heard it were amazed at what the shepherds said to them
verses.literalPt: E todos os que a ouviram se maravilharam do que os pastores lhes diziam.

verses.original: ἡ δὲ Μαρία πάντα συνετήρει τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα συμβάλλουσα ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτῆς
verses.transliteration: hē de Maria panta synetērei ta rhēmata tauta symballousa en tē kardia autēs
verses.literal: But Mary treasured up all these things and pondered them in her heart
verses.literalPt: Mas Maria guardava todas estas coisas, conferindo-as em seu coração.

verses.original: Καὶ ὑπέστρεψαν οἱ ποιμένες δοξάζοντες καὶ αἰνοῦντες τὸν Θεὸν ἐπὶ πᾶσιν οἷς ἤκουσαν καὶ εἶδον καθὼς ἐλαλήθη πρὸς αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: Kai hypestrepsan hoi poimenes doxazontes kai ainountes ton Theon epi pasin hois ēkousan kai eidon kathōs elalēthē pros autous
verses.literal: The shepherds returned glorifying and praising God for all they had heard and seen which was just as the angel had told them
verses.literalPt: E voltaram os pastores, glorificando e louvando a Deus por tudo o que tinham ouvido e visto, como lhes havia sido dito.

verses.original: Καὶ ὅτε ἐπλήσθησαν ἡμέραι ὀκτὼ τοῦ περιτεμεῖν αὐτόν καὶ ἐκλήθη τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ἰησοῦς τὸ κληθὲν ὑπὸ τοῦ ἀγγέλου πρὸ τοῦ συλλημφθῆναι αὐτὸν ἐν τῇ κοιλίᾳ
verses.transliteration: Kai hote eplēsthēsan hēmerai oktō tou peritemein auton kai eklēthē to onoma autou Iēsous to klēthen hypo tou angelou pro tou syllēmphthēnai auton en tē koilia
verses.literal: When the eight days before His circumcision had passed He was named Jesus the name - the angel had given Him before He was conceived . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: E, quando os oito dias foram cumpridos, para circuncidar o menino, foi-lhe dado o nome de Jesus, que pelo anjo lhe fora posto antes de ser concebido.

verses.original: Καὶ ὅτε ἐπλήσθησαν αἱ ἡμέραι τοῦ καθαρισμοῦ αὐτῶν κατὰ τὸν νόμον Μωϋσέως ἀνήγαγον αὐτὸν εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα παραστῆσαι τῷ Κυρίῳ
verses.transliteration: Kai hote eplēsthēsan hai hēmerai tou katharismou autōn kata ton nomon Mōuseōs anēgagon auton eis Hierosolyma parastēsai tō Kyriō
verses.literal: And when the time of purification according to the Law of Moses was complete His parents brought Him to Jerusalem to present Him to the Lord
verses.literalPt: E, cumprindo-se os dias da purificação dela, segundo a lei de Moisés, o levaram a Jerusalém, para o apresentarem ao Senhor

verses.original: καθὼς γέγραπται ἐν νόμῳ Κυρίου ὅτι Πᾶν ἄρσεν διανοῖγον μήτραν ἅγιον τῷ Κυρίῳ κληθήσεται
verses.transliteration: kathōs gegraptai en nomō Kyriou hoti Pan arsen dianoigon mētran hagion tō Kyriō klēthēsetai
verses.literal: (as it is written in the Law of the Lord Every firstborn . . . male shall be consecrated . . . to the Lord
verses.literalPt: (Segundo o que está escrito na lei do Senhor: Todo o macho primogênito será consagrado ao Senhor);

verses.original: καὶ τοῦ δοῦναι θυσίαν κατὰ τὸ εἰρημένον ἐν τῷ νόμῳ Κυρίου Ζεῦγος τρυγόνων ἢ δύο νοσσοὺς περιστερῶν
verses.transliteration: kai tou dounai thysian kata to eirēmenon en tō nomō Kyriou Zeugos trygonōn ē dyo nossous peristerōn
verses.literal: and to offer the sacrifice specified in the Law of the Lord A pair of turtledoves or two young pigeons
verses.literalPt: E para darem a oferta segundo o disposto na lei do SENHOR: Um par de rolas ou dois pombinhos.

verses.original: Καὶ ἰδοὺ ἄνθρωπος ἦν ἐν Ἰερουσαλὴμ ᾧ ὄνομα Συμεών καὶ ὁ ἄνθρωπος οὗτος δίκαιος καὶ εὐλαβής προσδεχόμενος παράκλησιν τοῦ Ἰσραήλ καὶ Πνεῦμα ἦν Ἅγιον ἐπ’ αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Kai idou anthrōpos ēn en Ierousalēm hō onoma Symeōn kai ho anthrōpos houtos dikaios kai eulabēs prosdechomenos paraklēsin tou Israēl kai Pneuma ēn Hagion ep’ auton
verses.literal: Now . . . there was a man in Jerusalem named Simeon - who was righteous and devout He was waiting for the consolation of Israel and the Holy Spirit was upon him
verses.literalPt: Havia em Jerusalém um homem cujo nome era Simeão; e este homem era justo e temente a Deus, esperando a consolação de Israel; e o Espírito Santo estava sobre ele.

verses.original: καὶ ἦν αὐτῷ κεχρηματισμένον ὑπὸ τοῦ Πνεύματος τοῦ Ἁγίου μὴ ἰδεῖν θάνατον πρὶν ἢ ἂν ἴδῃ τὸν Χριστὸν Κυρίου
verses.transliteration: kai ēn autō kechrēmatismenon hypo tou Pneumatos tou Hagiou mē idein thanaton prin ē an idē ton Christon Kyriou
verses.literal: The Holy Spirit had revealed to him that he would not see death before . . . . . . he had seen the Lord’s Christ
verses.literalPt: E fora-lhe revelado, pelo Espírito Santo, que ele não morreria antes de ter visto o Cristo do Senhor.

verses.original: καὶ ἦλθεν ἐν τῷ Πνεύματι εἰς τὸ ἱερόν καὶ ἐν τῷ εἰσαγαγεῖν τοὺς γονεῖς τὸ παιδίον Ἰησοῦν τοῦ ποιῆσαι αὐτοὺς κατὰ τὸ εἰθισμένον τοῦ νόμου περὶ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai ēlthen en tō Pneumati eis to hieron kai en tō eisagagein tous goneis to paidion Iēsoun tou poiēsai autous kata to eithismenon tou nomou peri autou
verses.literal: Led by the Spirit he went into the temple courts And when the parents brought in the child Jesus to do for Him what was customary under the Law
verses.literalPt: E pelo Espírito foi ao templo e, quando os pais trouxeram o menino Jesus, para com ele procederem segundo o uso da lei,

verses.original: καὶ αὐτὸς ἐδέξατο αὐτὸ εἰς τὰς ἀγκάλας καὶ εὐλόγησεν τὸν Θεὸν καὶ εἶπεν
verses.transliteration: kai autos edexato auto eis tas ankalas kai eulogēsen ton Theon kai eipen
verses.literal: Simeon took Him in his arms and blessed God saying
verses.literalPt: Ele, então, o tomou em seus braços, e louvou a Deus, e disse:

verses.original: Νῦν ἀπολύεις τὸν δοῦλόν σου Δέσποτα κατὰ τὸ ῥῆμά σου ἐν εἰρήνῃ
verses.transliteration: Nyn apolyeis ton doulon sou Despota kata to rhēma sou en eirēnē
verses.literal: Sovereign Lord as You have promised You now dismiss Your servant in peace
verses.literalPt: Agora, Senhor, despedes em paz o teu servo, Segundo a tua palavra;

verses.original: ὅτι εἶδον οἱ ὀφθαλμοί μου τὸ σωτήριόν σου
verses.transliteration: hoti eidon hoi ophthalmoi mou to sōtērion sou
verses.literal: For my eyes have seen Your salvation
verses.literalPt: Pois já os meus olhos viram a tua salvação,

verses.original: ὃ ἡτοίμασας κατὰ πρόσωπον πάντων τῶν λαῶν
verses.transliteration: ho hētoimasas kata prosōpon pantōn tōn laōn
verses.literal: which You have prepared in the sight of all people
verses.literalPt: A qual tu preparaste perante a face de todos os povos;

verses.original: φῶς εἰς ἀποκάλυψιν ἐθνῶν καὶ δόξαν λαοῦ σου Ἰσραήλ
verses.transliteration: phōs eis apokalypsin ethnōn kai doxan laou sou Israēl
verses.literal: a light for revelation to the Gentiles and for glory to Your people Israel
verses.literalPt: Luz para iluminar as nações, E para glória de teu povo Israel.

verses.original: Καὶ ἦν ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἡ μήτηρ θαυμάζοντες ἐπὶ τοῖς λαλουμένοις περὶ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai ēn ho patēr autou kai hē mētēr thaumazontes epi tois laloumenois peri autou
verses.literal: The Child’s father and mother were amazed at what was spoken about Him
verses.literalPt: E José, e sua mãe, se maravilharam das coisas que dele se diziam.

verses.original: καὶ εὐλόγησεν αὐτοὺς Συμεὼν καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς Μαριὰμ τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ Ἰδοὺ οὗτος κεῖται εἰς πτῶσιν καὶ ἀνάστασιν πολλῶν ἐν τῷ Ἰσραὴλ καὶ εἰς σημεῖον ἀντιλεγόμενον
verses.transliteration: kai eulogēsen autous Symeōn kai eipen pros Mariam tēn mētera autou Idou houtos keitai eis ptōsin kai anastasin pollōn en tō Israēl kai eis sēmeion antilegomenon
verses.literal: Then Simeon blessed them and said to His mother Mary Behold this Child is appointed to cause the rise and fall of many in Israel and to be a sign that will be spoken against
verses.literalPt: E Simeão os abençoou, e disse a Maria, sua mãe: Eis que este é posto para queda e elevação de muitos em Israel, e para sinal que é contraditado

verses.original: καὶ σοῦ δὲ αὐτῆς τὴν ψυχὴν διελεύσεται ῥομφαία ὅπως ἂν ἀποκαλυφθῶσιν ἐκ πολλῶν καρδιῶν διαλογισμοί
verses.transliteration: kai sou de autēs tēn psychēn dieleusetai rhomphaia hopōs an apokalyphthōsin ek pollōn kardiōn dialogismoi
verses.literal: so that the thoughts of many hearts . . . will be revealed and a sword will pierce your . . . soul as well
verses.literalPt: (E uma espada traspassará também a tua própria alma); para que se manifestem os pensamentos de muitos corações.

verses.original: Καὶ ἦν Ἅννα προφῆτις θυγάτηρ Φανουήλ ἐκ φυλῆς Ἀσήρ αὕτη προβεβηκυῖα ἐν ἡμέραις πολλαῖς ζήσασα μετὰ ἀνδρὸς ἔτη ἑπτὰ ἀπὸ τῆς παρθενίας αὐτῆς
verses.transliteration: Kai ēn Hanna prophētis thygatēr Phanouēl ek phylēs Asēr hautē probebēkuia en hēmerais pollais zēsasa meta andros etē hepta apo tēs parthenias autēs
verses.literal: There was also a prophetess named Anna the daughter of Phanuel of the tribe of Asher who was well along . . . in years She had been married . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . for seven years
verses.literalPt: E estava ali a profetisa Ana, filha de Fanuel, da tribo de Aser. Esta era já avançada em idade, e tinha vivido com o marido sete anos, desde a sua virgindade;

verses.original: καὶ αὐτὴ χήρα ἕως ἐτῶν ὀγδοήκοντα τεσσάρων ἣ οὐκ ἀφίστατο τοῦ ἱεροῦ νηστείαις καὶ δεήσεσιν λατρεύουσα νύκτα καὶ ἡμέραν
verses.transliteration: kai autē chēra heōs etōn ogdoēkonta tessarōn hē ouk aphistato tou hierou nēsteiais kai deēsesin latreuousa nykta kai hēmeran
verses.literal: and then was a widow to the age of eighty-four . . . . . . She never left the temple but worshiped night and day fasting and praying
verses.literalPt: E era viúva, de quase oitenta e quatro anos, e não se afastava do templo, servindo a Deus em jejuns e orações, de noite e de dia.

verses.original: καὶ αὐτῇ τῇ ὥρᾳ ἐπιστᾶσα ἀνθωμολογεῖτο τῷ Θεῷ καὶ ἐλάλει περὶ αὐτοῦ πᾶσιν τοῖς προσδεχομένοις λύτρωσιν Ἰερουσαλήμ
verses.transliteration: kai autē tē hōra epistasa anthōmologeito tō Theō kai elalei peri autou pasin tois prosdechomenois lytrōsin Ierousalēm
verses.literal: Coming forward at that moment she gave thanks to God and spoke about the Child to all who were waiting for the redemption of Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: E sobrevindo na mesma hora, ela dava graças a Deus, e falava dele a todos os que esperavam a redenção em Jerusalém.

verses.original: Καὶ ὡς ἐτέλεσαν πάντα τὰ κατὰ τὸν νόμον Κυρίου ἐπέστρεψαν εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν εἰς πόλιν ἑαυτῶν Ναζαρέθ
verses.transliteration: Kai hōs etelesan panta ta kata ton nomon Kyriou epestrepsan eis tēn Galilaian eis polin heautōn Nazareth
verses.literal: When Jesus’ parents had done everything required by the Law of the Lord they returned to Galilee to their own town of Nazareth
verses.literalPt: E, quando acabaram de cumprir tudo segundo a lei do Senhor, voltaram à Galiléia, para a sua cidade de Nazaré.

verses.original: Τὸ δὲ παιδίον ηὔξανεν καὶ ἐκραταιοῦτο πληρούμενον σοφίᾳ καὶ χάρις Θεοῦ ἦν ἐπ’ αὐτό
verses.transliteration: To de paidion ēuxanen kai ekrataiouto plēroumenon sophia kai charis Theou ēn ep’ auto
verses.literal: And the Child grew and became strong He was filled with wisdom and the grace of God was upon Him
verses.literalPt: E o menino crescia, e se fortalecia em espírito, cheio de sabedoria; e a graça de Deus estava sobre ele.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐπορεύοντο οἱ γονεῖς αὐτοῦ κατ’ ἔτος εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ τῇ ἑορτῇ τοῦ πάσχα
verses.transliteration: Kai eporeuonto hoi goneis autou kat’ etos eis Ierousalēm tē heortē tou pascha
verses.literal: Every year His parents went to Jerusalem for the Feast of the Passover
verses.literalPt: Ora, todos os anos iam seus pais a Jerusalém à festa da páscoa;

verses.original: Καὶ ὅτε ἐγένετο ἐτῶν δώδεκα ἀναβαινόντων αὐτῶν κατὰ τὸ ἔθος τῆς ἑορτῆς
verses.transliteration: Kai hote egeneto etōn dōdeka anabainontōn autōn kata to ethos tēs heortēs
verses.literal: And when He was twelve years old they went up according to the custom of the Feast
verses.literalPt: E, tendo ele já doze anos, subiram a Jerusalém, segundo o costume do dia da festa.

verses.original: καὶ τελειωσάντων τὰς ἡμέρας ἐν τῷ ὑποστρέφειν αὐτοὺς ὑπέμεινεν Ἰησοῦς ὁ παῖς ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ καὶ οὐκ ἔγνωσαν οἱ γονεῖς αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai teleiōsantōn tas hēmeras en tō hypostrephein autous hypemeinen Iēsous ho pais en Ierousalēm kai ouk egnōsan hoi goneis autou
verses.literal: When those days were over and they were returning home the boy Jesus remained behind in Jerusalem but His parents were unaware He had stayed
verses.literalPt: E, regressando eles, terminados aqueles dias, ficou o menino Jesus em Jerusalém, e não o soube José, nem sua mãe.

verses.original: νομίσαντες δὲ αὐτὸν εἶναι ἐν τῇ συνοδίᾳ ἦλθον ἡμέρας ὁδὸν καὶ ἀνεζήτουν αὐτὸν ἐν τοῖς συγγενεῦσιν καὶ τοῖς γνωστοῖς
verses.transliteration: nomisantes de auton einai en tē synodia ēlthon hēmeras hodon kai anezētoun auton en tois syngeneusin kai tois gnōstois
verses.literal: Assuming He was in their company they traveled on for a day before they began to look for Him among their relatives and friends
verses.literalPt: Pensando, porém, eles que viria de companhia pelo caminho, andaram caminho de um dia, e procuravam-no entre os parentes e conhecidos;

verses.original: καὶ μὴ εὑρόντες ὑπέστρεψαν εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ ἀναζητοῦντες αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: kai mē heurontes hypestrepsan eis Ierousalēm anazētountes auton
verses.literal: When they could not find Him they returned to Jerusalem to search for Him
verses.literalPt: E, como o não encontrassem, voltaram a Jerusalém em busca dele.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐγένετο μετὰ ἡμέρας τρεῖς εὗρον αὐτὸν ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ καθεζόμενον ἐν μέσῳ τῶν διδασκάλων καὶ ἀκούοντα αὐτῶν καὶ ἐπερωτῶντα αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: Kai egeneto meta hēmeras treis heuron auton en tō hierō kathezomenon en mesō tōn didaskalōn kai akouonta autōn kai eperōtōnta autous
verses.literal: Finally . . . after three days they found Him in the temple courts sitting among . . . the teachers listening to them and asking them questions . . .
verses.literalPt: E aconteceu que, passados três dias, o acharam no templo, assentado no meio dos doutores, ouvindo-os, e interrogando-os.

verses.original: ἐξίσταντο δὲ πάντες οἱ ἀκούοντες αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τῇ συνέσει καὶ ταῖς ἀποκρίσεσιν αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: existanto de pantes hoi akouontes autou epi tē synesei kai tais apokrisesin autou
verses.literal: And all who heard Him were astounded at His understanding and His answers
verses.literalPt: E todos os que o ouviam admiravam a sua inteligência e respostas.

verses.original: Καὶ ἰδόντες αὐτὸν ἐξεπλάγησαν καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτὸν ἡ μήτηρ αὐτοῦ Τέκνον τί ἐποίησας ἡμῖν οὕτως ἰδοὺ ὁ πατήρ σου κἀγὼ ὀδυνώμενοι ἐζητοῦμέν σε
verses.transliteration: Kai idontes auton exeplagēsan kai eipen pros auton hē mētēr autou Teknon ti epoiēsas hēmin houtōs idou ho patēr sou kagō odynōmenoi ezētoumen se
verses.literal: When His parents saw Him they were astonished Child why have You done this to us His mother asked . . . . . . Your father and I have been anxiously searching . . . for You
verses.literalPt: E quando o viram, maravilharam-se, e disse-lhe sua mãe: Filho, por que fizeste assim para conosco? Eis que teu pai e eu ansiosos te procurávamos.

verses.original: Καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς Τί ὅτι ἐζητεῖτέ με οὐκ ᾔδειτε ὅτι ἐν τοῖς τοῦ Πατρός μου δεῖ εἶναί με
verses.transliteration: Kai eipen pros autous Ti hoti ezēteite me ouk ēdeite hoti en tois tou Patros mou dei einai me
verses.literal: Why were you looking for Me He asked . . . . . . Did you not know that I had to be in My Father’s house
verses.literalPt: E ele lhes disse: Por que é que me procuráveis? Não sabeis que me convém tratar dos negócios de meu Pai?

verses.original: καὶ αὐτοὶ οὐ συνῆκαν τὸ ῥῆμα ὃ ἐλάλησεν αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: kai autoi ou synēkan to rhēma ho elalēsen autois
verses.literal: But they did not understand the statement He was making to them
verses.literalPt: E eles não compreenderam as palavras que lhes dizia.

verses.original: Καὶ κατέβη μετ’ αὐτῶν καὶ ἦλθεν εἰς Ναζαρὲθ καὶ ἦν ὑποτασσόμενος αὐτοῖς καὶ ἡ μήτηρ αὐτοῦ διετήρει πάντα τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτῆς
verses.transliteration: Kai katebē met’ autōn kai ēlthen eis Nazareth kai ēn hypotassomenos autois kai hē mētēr autou dietērei panta ta rhēmata tauta en tē kardia autēs
verses.literal: Then He went down to Nazareth with them - and was obedient to them But His mother treasured up all these things in her heart
verses.literalPt: E desceu com eles, e foi para Nazaré, e era-lhes sujeito. E sua mãe guardava no seu coração todas estas coisas.

verses.original: Καὶ Ἰησοῦς προέκοπτεν ἐν τῇ σοφίᾳ καὶ ἡλικίᾳ καὶ χάριτι παρὰ Θεῷ καὶ ἀνθρώποις
verses.transliteration: Kai Iēsous proekopten en tē sophia kai hēlikia kai chariti para Theō kai anthrōpois
verses.literal: And Jesus grew in wisdom and stature and in favor with God and man
verses.literalPt: E crescia Jesus em sabedoria, e em estatura, e em graça para com Deus e os homens.
